text:
Yes, there are aftermarket rear-seat screens for the Model Y. Tesla doesn't make one, so these are third-party products, and reviews are mixed. Which one fits depends on your model year.

## Option 1: 8.66" rear touchscreen (most popular)
These are Android tablets that mount on the back of the center console. They stream video, support wireless CarPlay, and control rear AC and seat heating. Most cost about $300-$330.

- **My pick: the 8.66" Rear Display, Android 13, 4GB+64GB, 8-core, $329.99.** It has the most reviews of the well-rated options (3.9 stars, 41 reviews) and lists Model Y 2019-2024 compatibility. [Amazon search results](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-back-seat-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+back+seat+screen) (find it by that title)
- **Similar:** the 8.66" 8-core 4GB+64GB for Model Y 2019-2024 at $319.99 has 3.7 stars (46 reviews). [Amazon search results](https://www.amazon.com/tesla-model-y-rear-screen/s?k=tesla+model+y+rear+screen)
- **Cheaper:** the Tlyard 8.66" is $210.99, but it has only one review, so I wouldn't count on its 5.0 rating. Same Amazon link as above.
- **Better return terms:** [TESERY 8.66" screen](https://www.tesery.com/products/tesery-8-66-inch-rear-entertainment-display-screen-for-tesla) is $359 with a 30-day return policy and a 4.7 average from 22 reviews. The written reviews are mixed, though. One buyer reported frequent child-lock lockups and failed app updates, and others mentioned lag. It's also listed for Model Y 2020 through March 2025 only.
- **Out of stock:** the [Aear 8.8" at SquareWheels](https://squarewheelsauto.com/products/rear-entertainment-screen-for-tesla-model-y) is $299 on sale but currently sold out.

Expect something slower than a real tablet. One TESERY reviewer called it "a little slow, but it is an aftermarket product."

## Option 2: Projector screen
If you'd rather watch movies while parked, such as when camping or charging, the [Aurzen TravelPlay AutoCinema Screen](https://aurzen.com/products/aurzen-travelplay-autocinema-screen-for-tesla-model-y) is $119.99. It's a clip-in screen and sunshade for rear-seat, tailgate, and sky-roof viewing. You need a separate projector, and it's for parked use only.

## Check your model year first
- If you have a **2025 or newer "Juniper" Model Y**, the Amazon listings only say 2019-2024, and TESERY stops at March 2025. Confirm fit with the seller before buying.
- Aurzen is designed for the 2025-2026 Model Y. It fits 2020-2024 in sky-roof mode, but the rear screen won't fully cover the window.

## Tips
- The Amazon listings I saw were mostly rated 3.5-3.9 stars, so buy somewhere with easy returns.
- Wi-Fi hotspot and CarPlay can't be used at the same time on the TESERY unit.
- The screens are meant for rear passengers, and some have auto screen-off for safety.

If you tell me your Model Y year, I can narrow it down to one.
